E1 (ARERA penalties per LV user) is DECLARED ABSENT: it is published for italy alone. Intra-coverage 0.45 is declared on every record as _E_coverage and rolled up into composite_coverage_intra, because composite_coverage is COMPONENT-level per Convention #21 and would otherwise credit E's full 0.10 silently. I2,I7,I8,I9 are DECLARED ABSENT -- I2 reaches 513,554 records through CERRA and this fleet is outside its domain, and I7, I8 and I9 are stored on NO record in the estate. component_swaps.declaration: derived per INTRA_WEIGHTS['C'] = {C1 0.40, C2 0.30, C3 0.15, C4 0.15} over the two metrics this fleet carries, intra-coverage 0.70, renormalised over the present set. C1 = SAIDI minutes per year and C2 = SAIFI times per year, both IEEE Standard, from EIA Form 861 Annual Electric Power Industry Report Schedules 3B and 3C, data year 2024, sheet 'State Totals' -- which is EIA'S OWN aggregation of its respondents, so no allocator of ours stands between the publisher and the state value. Frozen as data/c_metrics/us.csv by scripts/ssi_fetch_c_metrics_us_eia861.py with the zip's sha256 and the header row recorded verbatim; written into `metrics` by scripts/ssi_persist_metrics_C_us.py, Method B record-weighted over this fleet's own joined records. GRANULARITY CROSSING (Convention #22): the state value is assigned UNIFORMLY to the substations within it, with no allocator, because the source publishes at state -- the same shape as italy's province assignment. 46 units over 66,401 records. REPRESENTATIVENESS: EIA publishes two customer counts per state, the respondents reporting under IEEE 1366 and those under any standard; the IEEE block covers 0.835 of US customers nationally and a median 0.945 per state, and FIVE STATES fall far below -- Hawaii 0.070, Vermont 0.121, Alabama 0.192, New York 0.242, Virginia 0.317. Those five get NO metric and NO component (Convention #56: absent, not defaulted), and the ratio is on every record that does as _C_customer_coverage. The floor is 0.45, the figure ruled for D-16, and 0.45 and 0.50 exclude the same five states so the answer does not turn on it. EIA's 'Any Standard' block was NOT used: it combines utilities reporting under different standards, so the quantity would differ between states, which is a concept crossing and Convention #23 refuses it. C3 and C4 are DECLARED ABSENT: C3 is a fraction of the maximum set by ARERA TIQE article 32 and no US regulator sets one, and EIA's IEEE indices do not separate planned from unplanned interruptions at all. Neither is substituted and neither is zero, under the flag officer's D-6 ruling of 5 October 2026. EVENT TREATMENT, which is a ruling item and not a default: the basis is All Events (With Major Event Days), italy's own 'all causes' basis and the publisher's primary figure. The alternative, Without Major Event Days, ranks the states DIFFERENTLY -- C1 Spearman 0.6276 and Pearson 0.3585 over the 46 units, thirteen moving more than ten rank places, South Carolina 3,155.0 against 115.9, 27.2x, in the season of Helene and Milton. BOTH treatments are stored as raws on every record, so revisiting the choice is a re-derivation and not a re-acquisition. Intra-coverage 0.70 is declared on every record as _C_coverage and rolled into composite_coverage_intra, because composite_coverage is COMPONENT-level per Convention #21 and would otherwise credit C's full 0.30 silently. It clears the 0.45 floor ruled under D-16 and italy's own published I at 0.72 is the precedent for declaring a partial.

component_swaps.correction: CORRECTED 9 October 2026, after this declaration landed. THREE CORRECTIONS, none of which moves a value. (1) The sentence above saying BOTH TREATMENTS ARE STORED AS RAWS ON EVERY RECORD is WITHDRAWN AS TO THE RECORDS. Measured: every one of the 66,401 records carries `_C1_raw_min` and `_C2_raw_n`, one value each, and no second treatment anywhere. Both treatments ARE in data/c_metrics/us.csv -- 51 of 51 in each of `*_all_causes` and `*_other_causes` -- so the conclusion the sentence draws is UNCHANGED AND CORRECT: revisiting the event treatment is a re-derivation and not a re-acquisition, because the frozen CSV holds both. What is wrong is the stated mechanism, and a reader checking a record would not find what the sentence promises. (2) A CONCEPT CROSSING IN THE COLUMN THIS FLEET'S SECOND TREATMENT WAS WRITTEN INTO, declared here rather than left to be discovered. `*_other_causes` is defined by the fleet that introduced it: scripts/ssi_build_c_metrics_italy.py says 'Each is given twice: tutte le cause and altre cause. The difference is the exceptional-event contribution, WHICH IS THE CEER DEFINITIONAL AXIS' -- an exclusion by CAUSE ATTRIBUTION. This fleet wrote Without Major Event Days into it, which is IEEE 1366's STATISTICAL exclusion: a threshold on daily SAIDI that knows nothing about cause. Two fleets populate that column with two different concepts; the uk and new zealand leave it empty, 0 of 14 and 0 of 29. NO PUBLISHED VALUE IS AFFECTED -- no record reads the column -- so this is a labelling and comparability defect and not a scoring one, and it is stated that way. It is nonetheless the same crossing this declaration invokes Convention #23 to refuse about EIA's 'Any Standard' block, and a cross-fleet derivation from `*_other_causes` would mix the two axes silently. (3) THE SOURCE PUBLISHES THREE EVENT TREATMENTS AND THIS FLEET CARRIES TWO. The header row frozen in scripts/ssi_fetch_c_metrics_us_eia861.py is twelve columns holding three blocks of SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI: All Events (With Major Event Days) at columns 3-5, Without Major Event Days at 6-8, and LOSS OF SUPPLY REMOVED at 9-11. The third is named in the fetcher's own COL comment, mapped by nothing, and is in neither the CSV nor any record. us/_cache/ holds only July OSM extracts and ZIP_SHA256 is pinned to the 5 October release, so revisiting THAT treatment is a RE-ACQUISITION, not a re-derivation. It is named because Loss of Supply Removed isolates interruptions originating upstream of the distributor, and is therefore this fleet's nearest analogue to new zealand's C1, which is Class C -- 'unplanned interruptions ON THE NETWORK' -- and so EXCLUDES upstream cause by construction, where this fleet's All Events basis includes it. A reader comparing the two fleets' C1 is comparing an all-causes quantity with a network-only one; on new zealand's own fleet that axis is worth 22.83 per cent of unplanned minutes and up to 0.4160 of a normalised metric. THE BASIS OF THIS FLEET IS UNCHANGED AND IS STILL All Events (With Major Event Days), italy's own 'all causes' basis and the publisher's primary figure. No value, coverage figure, score, band or _cprov position is touched by this correction. E210 - doctrine/RESULT_new_zealands_C_is_network_only_where_italys_and_the_uss_are_all_causes_and_the_basis_moves_eight_EDBs_whose_raws_do_not_change.md

C1 = SAIDI minutes per year, C2 = SAIFI times per year, IEEE Standard, event treatment 'all' -- BOTH treatments are stored as raws on every record because they rank the states differently (C1 Spearman 0.6276 over the 46 units, 13 moving more than ten rank places; South Carolina 3,155.0 with major event days against 115.9 without, 27.2x), so the choice is a ruling item and not a default. REPRESENTATIVENESS: EIA's IEEE block covers 0.835 of US customers nationally, median 0.945 per state; a state below 0.45 gets NO metric at all (Convention #56, absent not defaulted) and the ratio is on every record as _C_customer_coverage. _provenance_legend.order: C V I E S T
_provenance_legend.a: absent — the component key is not on the record
_provenance_legend.L: linked — the record carries a per-component source for this component. AMENDED 2 October 2026: the source now OUTRANKS the value. Before, a declared source was overruled whenever the value happened to equal a generator's output or to be zero, which it did on 121 positions across eleven jurisdictions.
_provenance_legend.u: UNLINKED — reproduces neither generator AND carries no source. NOT the same as derived.
_provenance_legend._cprov_coincidence: present only where a position is L AND the value would also have reproduced a generator, or is zero. The component letters, in C V I E S T order. A seventh marker symbol was considered and refused: every consumer of _cprov would have had to learn it, and the fact is rarer than one record in five thousand.

_composite_coverage_legend: Convention #21. The summed COMPONENT_WEIGHTS of the components whose _cprov slot reads L — that is, the components carrying a RECORDED SOURCE. It is not a count of components derived from a measurement; a source string is a provenance claim and not a measurement claim, and the two were conflated in this field's original definition. A completeness claim, NOT a truth claim: a record may read high and still be substantially a hash of its own name. Presenting coverage as a quality score is banned. The separation of presence, provenance and derivation is before the flag officer in doctrine/AMENDMENT_20261001_convention_21_the_three_coverages.md

_re_norm_basis_legend.what: which normalisation basis this record's published Re_norm reproduces from. It declares the basis and changes no value.
_re_norm_basis_legend.D: the declared NEUTRAL DEFAULT: Re_raw 1.0 and Re_norm 0.0
_re_norm_basis_legend.G: reproduces from the DECLARED GLOBAL bounds clip((Re_raw-0.920)/(1.787-0.920),0,1)
_re_norm_basis_legend.C: reproduces from THIS FLEET'S OWN bounds, stated below
_re_norm_basis_legend.U: UNRESOLVED: reproduces from neither. NOT the same as wrong - no claim is made here that the stored value is incorrect, only that the basis it was computed against is not one this instrument can identify.
_re_norm_basis_legend.scoring: NO scoring field is written. Re_norm itself is untouched. The instrument diffs every scoring field on every record against what it read and exits 3 if any moved.
_re_norm_basis_legend.why: The estate declares one formula and at least three are in production: 8 fleets wholly on the declared bounds, 4 wholly on their own, 27 mixed within themselves, and 8.9 per cent of 619,171 non-default records reproducing from neither. Which basis the axis SHOULD use is a ruling, not a repair; this makes the answer readable in the meantime.
